executionTimeout.description:
Maximum amount of time that cell will be executed. If execution is not completed in time kernel will be interrupted.

If empty {@link JupyterLab.Session.CellExecutionSpec#timeout} will be used.
If execution is not completed in time kernel will be interrupted.

alwaysExecute.description:
If true, this cell will be executed even if one of the previous cells failed.
It may be useful for cells that do resource cleanup.

title: Represent instructions on how this cell should be executed. Usually stored in cell metadata under 'execSpec' key.
name: JupyterNotebook.Cell.ExecSpec
